_contract: The frozen identity of the Phase-C2 behavioural SCREENING battery. The bytes live outside git (heavy artifact); this record is what a reviewer and a launch verify them against. AUTHORIZES NOTHING and produces no verdict.
purpose: the Phase-C2 behavioural SCREENING battery: it ranks the Top-K full-search candidates against the incumbent B on one screening seed so that one candidate advances. It produces no GO/NO-GO verdict, may not promote anything, is never a promotion asset and is never training data.
mixture_rule: IDENTICAL to c1_confirmation_v1's, imported from that builder rather than restated: the frozen historical 3:3:3:3:3:2 over the scorable sets plus the same relative behaviour-only code component, scaled to 850/950. Screening and confirmation therefore measure correct_overall on the same distribution, which is what makes a screening delta informative about a confirmation delta.

sampling_rule.order: ascending cryptographic rank, ties by ascending stable id
sampling_rule._why_a_distinct_domain: so this is an INDEPENDENT cryptographic sample of the eligible pool rather than C1's next ranks. Reusing C1's domain would still be deterministic and disjoint, but the screening sample would be the tail of the confirmation sample's ordering.
sampling_rule.base_digest_source: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/plans/phase_c0_preregistration.json, commit be2ab08 — frozen long before any C2 candidate existed
sampling_rule.outcome_dependence: NONE — no model output of any kind is consulted. Not a Search-1 ranking, not a state_eval value, not a C1 probe result.
sampling_rule.difficulty_reweighting: none. Source-native metadata is retained on the items and may be reported, but does not stratify.
sampling_rule.filter: skip excluded ids and excluded normalized prompt hashes

disjoint_from_confirmation.why: C0's inferential unit is the prompt and same-prompt cross-seed dependence is substantial, so seed-disjointness alone would let the screening selection leak into the confirmation. Disjoint prompts AND disjoint seeds make the confirmation genuinely held out.

verification.determinism: an independent rebuild into a separate directory reproduced content_sha256 0ad76fc79f5e7ebf... exactly

disjointness_measured._method: measured independently of the builder's own guard, by loading both assets and intersecting stable ids and normalized prompt content hashes. The builder also refuses on any collision; this is the second, outside check. REMEASURED after the rank-domain repair.

verification.c1_battery_unaffected: battery_render.rank_key gained an optional `domain` defaulting to C1's, and c1_confirmation_v1 was rebuilt to prove it: content_sha256 a285d61f88de9da85e87818786cce8d350f03246365ff946207c61a6464fee3c reproduced exactly. The frozen C1 identity is untouched, and a regression now rebuilds it rather than trusting the default's spelling.

rank_domain_repair.what_was_wrong: rank_take accepted `domain` and did not forward it to rank_key, so every caller silently got DEFAULT_RANK_DOMAIN. The first build of this asset was therefore drawn under C1's ordering with C1's prompts excluded — disjoint, deterministic and exclusion-correct, but NOT sampled under the domain its manifest claimed.
rank_domain_repair._so_the_bug_was_load_bearing: the repaired sample differs from the first one in every stratum, which is why the asset was rebuilt rather than merely re-documented.
rank_domain_repair.regression: tests/data/test_c1_battery.py::test_rank_take_FORWARDS_its_domain_to_the_key pins the contract between rank_take and rank_key under three domains, and ::test_a_different_rank_domain_would_select_a_different_sample is the direct catch. Both were confirmed to FAIL with the bug reinstated.

what_it_may_not_do: produce a GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE verdict
serve as a promotion or final-promotion asset
be used as a beam-ranking input

reproducibility._mixture_and_sources_are_c1s: imported from build_c1_confirmation_battery rather than restated, so the two batteries differ in their sample and nothing else
